Name: Nyapu Style Downhill Project by AhCuteArt
Author: AhCuteArt
Description:
[center][size=5][b]Downhill Project [/b][/size][b][size=5]- Nyapu Style by AhCuteArt
[/size][/b][/center]

[b][size=5]
[/size][/b]I adore Nyapu's style portraits and custom NPCs. My passion project at the moment is to create Nyapu-style portraits for all the NPCs in my mega-modded SDV file. 

I've been a bit all over the place with my retextures. This is the last mod for this week's large drop.  I really liked the concept of the Downhill Project. Maybe when I am not swamped with mod projects... I'll try my hand at an NPC that I can add to their map. 

[b]INSTALLATION (Must have Smapi):
[/b]
1. ﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/32872]Downhill Project[/url]
2. ﻿Unzip and drag the replacement into your mods folder

[b]There are Two files:[/b]
[Main File] CP is just a drag and drop into your mods folder, and you're ready to go.

[Optional File] The portrait replacement overwrites the portraits. 
You should get a prompt to replace the original files if you do it right.
If you need more guidance, Nyapu has a great example on their page. 

[i][b]Extra:[/b]
In the original, the NPCs' winter outfits have a 50% chance of showing up. I coded it in my mod where they show up 100% of the time. Note that if you do the manual replacement, this feature won't be included. [/i]
[b]
[/b][i][b]CREDITS:[/b]
BIG thank you to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/54606682]nyapu[/url] for letting me use their art as a base. 
Thank you to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/106092643]Kiyugamods[/url] for allowing me to retexture their mod.
[/i]
[b][i]Shout Out!:[/i][/b]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/39361915]susurrusshivers[/url] made their own version of the Nyapu retextures. They made Anderson younger than I did. Check them out and choose whichever you like best: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/36422]Nyapu Style Downhill Project[/url]
[i]
[b]
[i][b]What am I working on?:[/b][/i]
[/b][i]If you're curious what I am working on next, please check out my social media page or my Nexus profile. [/i][/i]
